landed:
Wave 0 security commits are on HEAD (3f76ab4 worker, 057ef23 spa, b6fff2e README) — the baseline audit's go-live fixes, attacked by 4 reviewers + skeptics, 0 open. Read `git -C C:/Users/azooz/Desktop/sundus-yar/app show --stat 3f76ab4 057ef23` for the exact files. Facts you must build on (do not re-implement or revert):
- migrations/0007_users_email_verified_and_token_revocation.sql adds users.email_verified_at (ISO-8601 TEXT with CHECK, like 0005) and users.tokens_valid_after (INTEGER Unix seconds with CHECK). The plan's 0007/0008 become 0008_golive_admin_settings.sql / 0009_golive_hardening.sql and must NOT re-add these two columns.
- worker/auth.ts returns authTime (auth_time) and the second-factor claim; worker/users.ts loads the account (role, email, email_verified_at, erased_at, tokens_valid_after) centrally, re-syncs a verified email, refuses erased rows (410 ACCOUNT_ERASED) and revoked sessions (auth_time < tokens_valid_after → 401). Admin guard (worker/admin-auth.ts) = role admin + same verified email + not erased/revoked + auth_time ≤ 12 h; optional TOTP via the Wave 0 var ADMIN_REQUIRE_MFA (to be replaced by the plan's ADMIN_MEDIA_MFA / ADMIN_SETTINGS_2F in W1-02/W1-03).
- worker/http.ts has the streaming byte-capped JSON reader (readBoundedBytes/readJsonBody) used by every handler; HSTS on API responses. worker/rate-limit.ts wraps the `ratelimits` bindings (Wave 0 names BOOKING_RATE_LIMITER / PROFILE_RATE_LIMITER, namespaces 1001/1002 prod, 2001/2002 preview → rename to the plan's RL_* in W1-03/W1-15), allows when a binding is absent.
- worker/bookings.ts: atomic cap of 3 open requests in the INSERT WHERE (Wave 0 code TOO_MANY_OPEN_REQUESTS → the plan's OPEN_REQUEST_LIMIT), BOOKING_HORIZON_DAYS = 730 (shared/timing.ts), maxQuantityFor (shared/booking.ts), no past-date approval (409 EVENT_DATE_PASSED in admin-workflow).
- worker/index.ts: PREVIEW_READ_ONLY guard (403 PREVIEW_READ_ONLY), preview noindex from source; wrangler.jsonc has preview_urls:false and the env.preview block. public/_headers has COOP.
- worker/portal/portal-routes.ts + request.ts: central booking ownership helper and a recent-sign-in helper (Wave 0: private-media routes need auth_time ≤ 10 min → 401 REAUTH_REQUIRED; the plan changes reads to ≤ 12 h and the code to 403 REAUTH_REQUIRED — see your unit's extra acceptance).
- SPA: src/auth/AuthContext.tsx handles the Firebase MFA resolver + TOTP; src/auth/ReauthenticationHost.tsx + src/lib/modal-stack.ts = password re-check dialog with one retry; src/lib/server-error-messages.ts maps error codes to Arabic; src/auth/person-name.ts name rule; src/lib/ascii-digits.ts; src/features/admin-portal/AdminSecurityPanel.tsx = TOTP enrolment; displayName no longer set.
